shared_elements: upright slab/block with a vertical orientation and rounded top
suggestion of a face with eyes
justification: Both are upright monoliths whose surface presents a frontal face-like configuration — A a sculpted head with hollow eye sockets, brow and chin, B a low-relief mask-like composite at the top of a scrolled design — which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a three-dimensional, naturalistically modelled head with no linear ornament, while B is a flat, densely packed field of angular and curvilinear scroll motifs forming abstract composite creature imagery covering the whole slab.
